title: Recompute task_bytes on the incremental import route so checkout-versus-blob length differences can't carry forward and wrongly reject near the 128 MiB limit
outcome: Recompute task_bytes on the incremental import route so checkout-versus-blob length differences can't carry forward and wrongly reject near the 128 MiB limit
acceptance: The incremental import's task_bytes accounting uses one length basis (Git blob length) throughout; a store whose recorded total came from checkout lengths is recomputed once at cutover, not carried forward

A regression test with CRLF-converted checkout files near the task-bytes limit shows the incremental route accepts a folder that a complete read accepts, and still refuses one that is genuinely over the limit
